name: QuestionCard
purpose: A gated human-in-the-loop question during an intake workflow. On an existing app this is a visual spec. Behavior below is implemented only when the pattern is newly built.
behavioralRules: Never render an open-ended input without preset suggested options if suggestions exist.
Leave as gap emits isGap: true rather than submitting empty text.
A new question announces through aria-live polite and does not move focus.
The active suggestion uses sparq-mark and aria-pressed. State is never color alone.
Suggested answers are real buttons with a 24px minimum hit area.

adoption.apply: Restyle the existing question with Sparq type, a hairline, and a visible focus style. Keep the same controls and the same handlers.
suggest: If leaving a gap currently submits empty text, a later change can emit isGap: true. Do not make that change during a visual stage.
Announcing a new question in a polite live region, without moving focus, is behavior. Suggest it. Do not add it during a visual stage unless the region already announces.
